meta.name: skill-usage-audit
meta.description: Scan all artefacts (epics, stories, PRDs) for Base Rule

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描史诗、故事和PRD，自动检查基础规则合规性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要确保所有产品需求文档遵循既定基础规则
copy.tagline_en: Scan epics, stories, and PRDs for base rule compliance automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure all product requirement documents follow base rules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自动扫描所有epic和story文件，检查它们的frontmatter是否包含skills_invoked和related_decs字段，然后生成一份审计报告，列出每个文件的通过/失败状态和总体合规率。
howto.when: 当你要求进行合规审计（例如说“/gaai-status”或“检查技能使用”时），或在项目里程碑、发现会议后周期性触发。

say.note: Claude会扫描并报告缺失字段的文件。

say.text: 执行一次合规审计，生成报告。
say.note: 报告会显示通过率和违规列表。

howto.what_en: Claude scans all epic and story files, checks their frontmatter for required fields (skills_invoked, related_decs), and produces an audit report with pass/fail per file and overall compliance rate.
howto.when_en: Triggered on demand via "/gaai-status" or direct request, or periodically after discovery sessions, before releases, or when compliance trust needs verification.

say_en.text: Scan all epics and stories for skills_invoked.
say_en.note: Claude scans and reports missing fields.

say_en.text: Run a compliance audit and show report.
say_en.note: Report includes pass rate and violations.
